meta.title: Questions
meta.description: Quick answers for people looking for a job and for people hiring.

faq.title: Questions
faq.sub: Quick answers for people looking for a job and for people hiring.

items.a: Yes. Finding a walk-in and getting a token is free.

items.q: Can I get a token from home?
items.a: No. Tokens are given at the venue when check-in is open. Your place in line then shows on your phone.

Scan the QR on the lobby screen (or type the code shown), enter your name and phone, and you get a token. The front desk can issue a pass if a phone can't scan. Each drive allows one active token per phone number and per device.

items.q: What happens if I miss my call?
items.a: Go to the front desk within 10 minutes of the call. They can put you back in line.

items.q: How is the wait time worked out?
items.a: From the number of people ahead of you and how long recent interviews at that drive have taken. It changes as rounds move.

items.q: What if I can't make it?
items.a: Open your token and tap "I can't make it". Your place goes to the people behind you.

items.q: How do we list a walk-in?
items.a: Start hiring, add the role, venue, date and time, rounds and documents. Turn on the public listing and it shows on the walk-in list.
Recruiters who read resumes, write notes and record decisions sign in with their work email. Front-desk staff can call and check in candidates with a Desk PIN, no account needed.

items.q: Can we run several rooms and rounds at once?
items.a: Yes. Add as many rounds and rooms as you need. Each recruiter calls the next person into their own room.

They scan the QR on the lobby screen (or type the code shown), enter their name and phone, and they get a token. The front desk can issue a pass if a phone can't scan. Each drive allows one active token per phone number and per device.

items.q: Can we export to our ATS?
items.a: Yes. Export a CSV or Excel file with name, phone, role, notes and the decision from every round.
Start with a pilot. Tell us about your drives and we'll talk through pricing with you.

howPage.label: HOW IT WORKS
howPage.title: One queue, from the gate to the final round.
howPage.sub: What candidates do, and what employers do, at the same moment.
howPage.colCandidate: If you're looking for a job
sr: Before the day. Candidates find a walk-in and register. Employers set up and publish the drive.
At the venue. Candidates scan the lobby QR or type the code. Employers show the lobby screen and can issue a desk pass.
In the rooms. Candidates wait on their token page. Employers call the next person and run the rooms.
After. Candidates see round results on the token page. Employers wrap up and export a file for their ATS.

forCo.sub: If you hire in person, you know the day: hundreds of people, paper resumes, and nobody sure who's next. TokenHire gives you one queue and one clean file.

problem.title: What drive day looks like now

items.d: Everyone arrives at opening time and waits outside for hours.
Resumes get stacked, lost and typed into sheets late at night.
Names are shouted, some people are called twice and some never.
Every candidate gets a number at the venue and sees their place in line on their phone.
Each recruiter calls the next person into their room, round by round.
Front-desk staff call and check in candidates with a PIN. No account needed.
One clean file with name, phone, role, notes and every decision.
